anomaly.rule: |Δ| (bp) ≥ 0.975 quantile (linear interpolation, type 7) of |Δ| over the 250 most recent valid prior daily changes of the same official series; equal to the cutoff = YES; fewer than 250 valid prior changes = UNASSESSABLE (excluded from that estimator's denominator, never FALSE).
anomaly.measures: membership in a statistical tail of the series' own recent history; it is not market relevance, not a hit rate and not predictive accuracy
anomaly.notTheDetectorRule: This is an empirical 250-session percentile, not the detector's 60-session robust-scale / 8bp cutoff, and reviewers do not see detector output.

integrity.question: Do the tool's evidence values, session date and availability time match the official record?
integrity.rule: VALUE_ERROR: shown value differs from the official CSV by >0.5bp. TIMESTAMP_ERROR: wrong session date or a time earlier than publication (~18:00 ET). AVAILABILITY_ERROR: claimed available before it could be known. OK otherwise.

context.question: Is there an explanation? Recorded separately; it never changes the primary label.
context.rule: SCHEDULED: a release in release-calendar.json on the session (FOMC, CPI, NFP) or a scheduled auction. DOCUMENTED_UNSCHEDULED: contemporaneous official or major-wire record of an unscheduled event. UNEXPLAINED: searched, none found. UNAVAILABLE: could not search.

sensitivityAnalyses.rule: reported beside the primary 0.975 result; never chosen or tuned after labels

reporting: Population track: Hájek estimates weighted by 1/inclusionProbability with stratified-bootstrap intervals (skills/signals/scripts/estimators.py). Emitted-episode track: share of ANOMALY_CONFIRMED among assessable detector episodes (statistical-tail agreement) and, separately, integrity error rate. Boundary track: diagnostic only. Agreement: Cohen's kappa on integrity and on context.
doNotClaim: a pooled estimate over all roster items
